class.name: algo_nav2_plugins/GridPlanner
class.description:
Generic Nav2 global planner backed by the algo_core algorithm registry. The `algorithm` parameter selects which registered algorithm runs, so one plugin class exposes astar, dijkstra, gbfs, weighted_astar, jps, theta_star, d_star_lite and anything registered later.
Register several named instances of this class in planner_plugins to keep the algorithms loaded simultaneously and select one per request through the ComputePathToPose planner_id field.
